financial_benefits.name: Pudhumai Penn Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Higher Education Financial Assistance
financial_benefits.provider: Tamil Nadu Higher Education & Social Welfare Department
eligibility: Female student
Studied Class 6 to 12 in Tamil Nadu Government Schools
Enrolled in Undergraduate Degree, Diploma, ITI, or Professional course
documents_required: Class 6 to 12 School Study / TC Certificates
College Admission Fee Receipt & Student ID Card

financial_benefits.name: Kalaignar Magalir Urimai Thittam (KMUT)
eligibility: Female head of family
Family annual income below ₹2.5 lakh
Annual electricity consumption below 3,600 units
Valid Tamil Nadu Smart Ration Card holder
documents_required: Tamil Nadu Smart Family Card (Ration Card)

financial_benefits.name: Dr. Muthulakshmi Reddy Maternity Financial Benefit Scheme
financial_benefits.provider: Health and Family Welfare Department, Govt. of Tamil Nadu
eligibility: Pregnant women aged 19 years and above
Applicable for first two deliveries
Registered in PICME portal within 12 weeks of pregnancy

financial_benefits.name: Chief Minister's Girl Child Protection Financial Deposit Scheme
financial_benefits.provider: Department of Social Welfare & Women Empowerment, Tamil Nadu
eligibility: Family with 1 or 2 girl children and no male child
One parent sterilized before age 35
Family annual income below ₹72,000
Permanent resident of Tamil Nadu for minimum 10 years

financial_benefits.name: Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Marriage Assistance Scheme
financial_benefits.provider: Social Welfare Department, Govt. of Tamil Nadu
financial_benefits.amount: ₹25,000 to ₹50,000 Financial Grant + 8 Grams 22kt Gold Coin
eligibility: Bride aged 18 years or older
Bride passed 10th standard or Degree/Diploma
Family annual income below ₹72,000

financial_benefits.name: Unemployed Youth Employment Generation Programme (UYEGP) Subsidy
financial_benefits.provider: MSME Department, Govt. of Tamil Nadu
financial_benefits.amount: Up to ₹1.25 Lakh (25% Capital Subsidy on Project Cost up to ₹15 Lakhs)
eligibility: Unemployed youth aged 18 to 45 years (relaxation for women/SC/ST)
Minimum 8th pass qualification
Family annual income below ₹5 lakh
Resident of Tamil Nadu for minimum 3 years
documents_required: 8th Pass Marksheet or higher degree certificate

financial_benefits.name: New Entrepreneur-cum-Enterprise Development Scheme (NEEDS)
financial_benefits.provider: MSME Department, Govt. of Tamil Nadu
financial_benefits.amount: Up to ₹75 Lakhs (25% Capital Subsidy + 3% Interest Subvention)
eligibility: Educated first-generation entrepreneur aged 21 to 45 years
Degree, Diploma, ITI, or Vocational training qualification
Setting up new manufacturing or service enterprise in Tamil Nadu

financial_benefits.name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC/ST/SCC Students
financial_benefits.type: Full Tuition Fee Waiver & Maintenance Grant
financial_benefits.provider: Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare Department, Tamil Nadu
financial_benefits.amount: 100% Tuition Fee Reimbursement + ₹12,000 Annual Maintenance Allowance
eligibility: SC / ST / Scheduled Caste Converted Christian student
Family annual income below ₹2.5 lakh
Enrolled in Post-Matric, Diploma, UG, or PG course in Tamil Nadu
documents_required: Community Certificate issued by competent authority
College Admission Fee Structure & Student ID

financial_benefits.name: BC/MBC/DNC Higher Education Post-Matric Scholarship
financial_benefits.provider: Backward Classes, Most Backward Classes & Minorities Welfare Department
financial_benefits.amount: ₹6,000 to ₹20,000 per annum + Hostel Fee Exemption
eligibility: BC / MBC / DNC category student
Family annual income below ₹2.5 lakh
Pursuing 3-year Degree, Engineering, Medicine, Agriculture, or Diploma

financial_benefits.name: Tamil Nadu Destitute Widow Financial Pension Scheme
financial_benefits.provider: Revenue & Disaster Management Department, Tamil Nadu
eligibility: Destitute widow female resident of Tamil Nadu
Age 18 years and above
Family annual income below ₹72,000

financial_benefits.name: Tamil Nadu Maintenance Allowance Scheme for Differently Abled
financial_benefits.provider: Department for Welfare of Differently Abled Persons, Tamil Nadu
eligibility: Persons with 40% or more disability benchmark
Resident of Tamil Nadu
Family income within prescribed limits
documents_required: National Disability ID Card (UDID) / Disability Certificate

financial_benefits.name: Uzhavar Padhukappu Thittam (Farmers Security Educational & Pension Grant)
financial_benefits.provider: Revenue Department, Govt. of Tamil Nadu
eligibility: Registered small/marginal farmer or agricultural landless labourer in Tamil Nadu
Enrolled member of Uzhavar Padhukappu Thittam card
documents_required: Land Chitta / Adangal or Agricultural Labour Certificate

financial_benefits.name: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister Fellowship Financial Grant
financial_benefits.provider: Special Programme Implementation Department, Tamil Nadu
eligibility: Postgraduate or Professional degree holder from recognized university
First class academic record
Native or resident of Tamil Nadu
